note: The worked example (tools/quests/homelands/README.md). The Roost's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Aviak Village): Elder Kraawk gives the first two, Huntmaster Arrok beside him the three hunts; Weaver Tikkri is the outfitter, Coachman Harrek keeps the stable (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes); the scrub rats (south grass), the brush wasps (the hill to the west) and the boar Razortusk (the east rise) are placed for these quests.

L1.name: A Fledgling's Wingband
offer: Another fledgling, fresh from the egg! Every young one of the Roost wears a wingband before its first hunt, so the sentinels know it for ours.
Weaver Tikkri knots them from reed and down. Her loom is a short hop south-west of here.
Will you fetch your wingband and show it to me?
L1.declined: The Roost will wait for you, little one.
L1.started: Go on, then. Tikkri's loom is just south-west of here.

piece.name: fledgling's wingband
piece.description: A band of knotted reed and down. Every fledgling of the Roost wears one on its wing.

fetch.journal: Ask Weaver Tikkri, south-west of Elder Kraawk, for a fledgling's wingband.
fetch.says: The elder sent you? Hold out your wing. There: reed for strength, down for luck. No charge for a fledgling.

show.journal: Show the fledgling's wingband to Elder Kraawk.
show.says: It sits well on you. Wear it, and the Roost will always know its own.

L2.name: Bound to the Roost
offer: The winds carry fledglings far, and not always gently. Have Spiritmaster Kreeal bind your spirit to the Roost, so that you wake here if you fall.
Then give your name to Coachman Harrek for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then fly low until you do.
L2.started: Kreeal keeps the spirit perch to the north-west. Harrek's stable is on the path north of here.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Kreeal, north-west of the elder, bind your spirit to the Roost.
bind.says: It is done. Should you fall, you will wake here among your own. Now go and give Coachman Harrek your name.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Harrek, north of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: Welcome to my stable, fledgling. My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good. Now you will always find your way back to us.
Harrek's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the flight to Halas is earned. Huntmaster Arrok, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Rats Among the Seed
offer: So you are the new fledgling. Good. Scrub rats are into the seed stores again, and the grocer is squawking.
Hunt them on the grass south of the Roost and bring me three of their tails. Then I will teach you something worth knowing.
L3.declined: Then the rats eat well tonight.

drop.name: scrub rat tail
drop.description: The tail of a scrub rat from the grass south of the Roost.

hunt.journal: Take three scrub rat tails from the scrub rats on the grass south of the Roost.

give.journal: Bring three scrub rat tails to Huntmaster Arrok.
give.says: Three tails, and all your feathers still in place. You can fight. Now watch closely, and learn this.

L4.name: A Fledgling's Arms
offer: Bare talons will not serve you in the north. I will make you proper gear, but you will fetch what I need.
Weaver Tikkri has leather and a good shaft for me. Then take a stinger from the brush wasps on the hill west of the Roost.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then keep to your talons, and to the nest.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Tikkri, a stinger from the wasps. Go.

materials.journal: Ask Weaver Tikkri for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Arrok? Here, a strip of leather and a straight shaft. Tell him he owes me a rat pelt.

drop.name: brush wasp stinger
drop.description: The stinger of a brush wasp from the hill west of the Roost.

hunt.journal: Take a brush wasp stinger from the brush wasps on the hill west of the Roost.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the brush wasp stinger to Huntmaster Arrok.
give.says: All three. Give me a moment... there. It is yours: carry it well.

L5.name: Old Razortusk
offer: One task more before the winds take you north. An old boar we call Razortusk has gored two of our foragers on the east rise.
He is mean and he is quick, so strike first. Bring me his tusk, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a fledgling.
L5.declined: He will not grow gentler while you wait.
L5.started: East, up the rise past the market nests. Do not let him get behind you.

drop.name: Razortusk's tusk
drop.description: The chipped tusk of the old boar Razortusk.

hunt.journal: Take Razortusk's tusk from the old boar Razortusk on the rise east of the Roost.

give.journal: Bring Razortusk's tusk to Huntmaster Arrok.
says: Razortusk's own tusk! The foragers will sleep easier. You are a fledgling no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Windwhistle when you are ready to fly north.

flight.name: The Long Flight
offer: The winds are fair for the north. The barbarians of Halas fight the giants beside us, and they will train you as their own.
I can send you to them, but the wind blows one way: you will not fly back.
flight.declined: The winds will wait for you.
flight.started: Fly well, and do not forget the Roost!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Windwhistle when you are ready to fly to Halas.
